text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh, this is it! Right here, right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Here she comes, Cesario!
Cesario! Cesario!”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaahhhhhh————!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Cesario catches up and crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, ha...—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Alright.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: There, there... Ah, I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, I did it...!
I really did it, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Club Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gyaah!
Cesario-sensei! So cool~~!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, amazing!! Hey, Mom,
I want to run just like that Umamusume too!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Heh—better than expected... indeed.

Grandstands roaring with cheers.
The joy and tears of the Umamusume who finished the race—
Cesario seemed to be listening intently to all of it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (As expected, this place... is dazzling.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (A place where my heart burns, is dazzled, and finds the ultimate joy—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (...And that is precisely why I...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...My own, place...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I may have come all this way
without ever realizing there was another path.)
—After the Oaks came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I was able to show the results of my training.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'd like nothing more than to share this
emotion with you right this instant, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Regarding that matter we discussed earlier.

True, she did tell me earlier that
she wanted to talk after the Yushun Himba (Oaks).

"Still, from this atmosphere...
it seems she's in no state to talk right now."
choice_data_list: Do you need a little more time?
Do you need a bit more time?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right...
I'd just like a little more time to summarize it.
choice_data_list: Got it. You can tell me whenever you feel ready to talk.
Got it. Just tell me whenever you feel ready to talk, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
And thank you very much.

"And so, Cesario
left the racetrack early, all on her own."
While waiting for her, I was preparing for the coming Shuka Sho when—
(Knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Great job at the Oaks.
It was a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, excuse me.
I came here to deliver a package to you."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Goodness...! It's an invitation to a race, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (The Triple Tiara is a battle for three crowns that shines with supreme brilliance. I know that firsthand.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(And that's why my mind
must have been completely shut off all this time.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(If I run there and leave my mark,
I can become someone worthy of this vessel, right?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Still... what if there's another place
where I can shine the brightest—?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...Ever since I read Kraft's letter,
that possibility has been lingering in my mind...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (That being said, I haven't quite pinpointed where my "brightest stage" truly is.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Heh...
I said I'd summarize it, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Should I just...
come clean and tell the whole truth?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Right after that 'Oaks'—
—Why the long face?
(Why looking so glum?)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! You watched it.
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Just a little.
I've found myself feeling lost about the path I should take."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...
...I see—that works out nicely...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I came here—
to propose a "path."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: At the Oka Sho, I saw your running... and afterwards, I learned of your dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Nurturing the next generation—
and my deep involvement—in that—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "So that is—your dream. Then—in that case—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A challenge to the world.
At her quiet words—time stands still.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A new path――known as the world.
You shall――show it to them.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The world... to...―

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Among the myriad—races of the world—the pinnacle Arc
—the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'. Derbies of every nation and...
invitational races—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And――the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――If it's you――
You're the one... If it's you, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will show them, without fail.
Illuminated by the setting sun, Cesario's cheeks gradually flush red.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To America, and then to England in the summer...!
Please let me go win the Oaks!
Hearing those words, my hands freeze.
choice_data_list: America and England in the summer—

text_block_list.text:
In other words... you wish to challenge
the "Oaks" across three different countries?

In the first place, no Japanese Umamusume has ever won either of them.
If we're aiming for victory, we'll need an unprecedented, mind-blowing idea—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I-I'm serious about this...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I received that letter from Craft,
I've slowly been thinking more and more
about the path I ought to take...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Is the Triple Tiara truly the right path?
Shouldn't we be forging our own way rather than imitating others...?!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And today, led by destiny,
I was finally able to meet you...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To find the answer to...
"The place where I shine the brightest"!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: There are still very few cases of Japanese Umamusume succeeding overseas—and victories by those from the Tiara route are exceptionally rare!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Across Japan, America, and Great Britain,
I will sprint through my battlefields!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
This is the indispensable 'Path'...
'Sensei'—this is the 'radiance' essential for the foundation!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the "Oaks" across three nations—Japan, the US, and Europe—
that is truly where Cesario shines brightest,
and right now—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, my heart... is trembling so fiercely!
Trainer...!"

Three whole countries—this was developing too fast.
A warning bell rang in the back of my mind:
rash decisions lead to ruin.

Overseas expeditions take a heavy toll on the body in the first place.
She already has lingering concerns about her legs as it is. But—
Even though I knew that was the case—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how does it look...?

Normally so calm and collected, she couldn't
hide her immense joy as she passionately shared her dream.

"If I can't live up to that,
what kind of Trainer am I...?!"
choice_data_list: If we're doing this, let's go with whatever's more exciting!

text_block_list.text: (BAM!)

...With that, I forcefully placed something on the table.
Yes, what I had received from Tazuna-san
just a moment ago!

An invitation to an international Classic-exclusive race—
the American Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaaah...!
T-Trainer! Traineeeer~~~!!
After that, Cesario finally calmed down, and while making a promise to take even greater care in monitoring and conditioning her legs going forward—
First, on to the American Oaks!

And after that, we were set to head to the final leg
of the Triple Tiara, the autumn "Shuka Sho"!
